functions.name: decodeUtf8
functions.notes: Writes a -1 sentinel to the state word, then either a decoded code point or the original truncation/error result.

validation.comparison: Every case asserts the i32 result and the state word. 33 cases additionally assert all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer. All 256 one-byte inputs and all 7,680 two-byte lead/continuation pairs are exhaustive; 3/4-byte boundaries, truncation and random words are sampled.
limitations: Callers own input/output pointer validity; boundary pointers trap identically.
The decoder does not enforce the Unicode 0x10FFFF ceiling, matching the original.
Ledger: 337 client bodies recovered and 3,908 remain machine code.
